mechanism: Amikacin enhances quinidine's cardiac effects and increases risk of ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity; both drugs have additive effects on cardiac conduction and amikacin may increase quinidine serum concentrations if renal function declines.
action: Monitor cardiac function closely with ECG surveillance, assess renal function regularly, monitor for ototoxicity symptoms, and consider alternative antibiotics if possible; use lowest effective amikacin doses with careful therapeutic drug monitoring of quinidine.
